description: Sets or clears the app's public slug (the readable name in <slug or id>.neblla.app), at least 5 characters. Changing it changes the public URL. `slug: null` removes it. An old slug keeps leading to the app (it stays the app's; nobody else can take it), and the users' sessions follow. `move: true` takes a slug from another app of yours (e.g. moving a game to a new app): the other app loses it and its address leads to this one from then on. At least 5 characters. Changing it changes the public URL.

move.description: Take it from another app of yours that holds it (its slug or an old one)

slug.description: Wanted slug (lowercase letters, digits, dashes), or null to clear

name: neblla_set_slug
title: Set slug
